source: Supabase production readback and GitHub recovery workflow
root_cause: The deployed social-recovery-runner invokes undefined bearer(req). Its GitHub recovery workflow lacked a recurrent trigger and previously selected a dated manual recovery ledger on nonmanual runs.
prevention: Define Bearer header parser and reject any unauthorized service role request.
Schedule same-day recovery on independent GitHub Actions cron, using Europe/Amsterdam date instead of historical manual ledger.
Preserve content pre-publish gates, provider-specific truth readback and duplicate prevention.
Treat provider entitlement and scopes as distinct non-code boundaries requiring legitimate authorization.
Never count a scheduled action as a delivered post, email or DM.

evidence.learning_evaluation_note: Canary checks are no-send contract assertions; they do not constitute a live provider publication or Supabase production deployment.
